title: What's New in OmniNims v1.1.0
features: Full-window thumbnail organizer grid with multi-page selection (Ctrl and Ctrl+Shift)
Non-contiguous reverse ordering for selected page ranges (e.g. 1, 6-9)
Optimized 3 MB compression threshold notice preventing premature compression
Over-The-Air (OTA) update system with in-app release notes dialog
Unsaved changes exit confirmation protection on Alt+F4 and window close
File-scoped undo/redo isolation preventing history bleeding across documents
fixes: Fixed PDF compression to prevent redundant re-compression runs
Enhanced document security handling with AES-256 encryption in background isolate
